subject.title: [Feature]: Allow topic/forum cron deliveries to use main-session announce/agent-turn flow instead of forced direct delivery

question: Should text-only isolated cron completions for thread/topic targets support an opt-in main-agent processing route, and which public API plus fallback behavior should own it?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but adding this route changes cron's public config/protocol and delivery failure behavior, and repository policy treats config/default/fallback surfaces as compatibility-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Add job-level route enum
options.body: Add a narrow per-job text completion route selector that defaults to direct delivery, applies only to text-only thread/topic completions, and has explicit fail-closed or direct-fallback semantics.

options.title: Add global default plus override
options.body: Add a global cron default with per-job override for operators who want consistent topic behavior across many jobs, accepting a wider config surface.

options.title: Keep direct delivery only
options.body: Preserve current thread/topic direct-send behavior and document target-awareness or message-tool patterns as the supported alternatives.

recommendation.title: Add job-level route enum
recommendation.body: Add a narrow per-job text completion route selector that defaults to direct delivery, applies only to text-only thread/topic completions, and has explicit fail-closed or direct-fallback semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the current cron thread/topic delivery boundary and route-selector-adjacent config/protocol surface.
